notes: Cross-validated against CueScript's own product page (cuescript.tv/product-profile.php?pid=CSTM22), Markertek, and CVP.com — all report identical screen size (21.5" diag, 1920x1080), dimensions (530x346x48mm), weight (3.72kg/8.2lb), brightness (1500 cd/m2), and power (12V DC via 4-pin XLR), confirming this manual (titled "CSTMN"/"CSTML" — the internal engineering names for the commercially-sold TM22/TM24) describes the TM22. Rear-panel photo and connector sections in the manual show: a 3-BNC group serving Composite(CVBS)/Component(YPbPr)/RGB duty (only CVBS/Y, Pb, Pr are separately labeled — RGB reuses the same 3 BNCs per the OSD input menu), a VGA D-sub, a DVI connector, and a 3-BNC SDI group (SDI1 in, SDI2 in, one re-generated/looped SDI output). SDI is only specified as "HD-SDI and SD-SDI" with no 3G/6G mention, so graded sdi-hd (not higher). The on-screen INPUT menu also lists an "HDMI" option, but no HDMI connector appears in the manual's rear-panel photo or connector documentation for this unit — likely a shared/generic OSD firmware option not physically wired on the TM22, so it was omitted here as unconfirmed. DVI pinout/type (DVI-I vs DVI-D) is not spelled out in the manual, so "dvi" was used as the closest generic id. Desktop/hang-under-prompter unit — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted.

ports.name: CVBS / Y
ports.note: Shared with component Y; composite PAL/NTSC/SECAM, 75 ohm terminated

ports.name: Pb
ports.note: Component video Pb, part of shared 3-BNC component/RGB group

ports.name: Pr
ports.note: Component video Pr, part of shared 3-BNC component/RGB group

ports.name: VGA
ports.note: 15-pin HD D-sub, standard VGA pinout, auto-scaled to panel native resolution

ports.name: HD-SDI Output
ports.note: Re-generated/looped copy of currently selected SDI1 or SDI2 input

ports.name: DC Power In
ports.note: 4-pin XLR male, 12V DC regulated, ~4.3A/52W max; pin1=GND, pin4=+12V
